caption: The drawing depicts a large, stoneware jug with a light brown or beige surface and two extended handles curving from the neck to the shoulder. There is a small, centered spout at the top, and a metal-collared opening near the base, likely for dispensing liquids. The surface of the jug is decorated with blue floral patterns, consisting of several stylized flowers and leafy stems, centered on the front of the jug. At the top of the jug, above the decoration, blue printed text reads "HUBBELL & CHESBRO / GOSHEN, N.Y." Below the central floral motif, there is blue cursive writing, including the name "Gilson." The drawing’s background is a plain, off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Water or Cider Jug
